description: Student login for 20-30 student classes: teacher-started code, name list, 3-picture password, QR login card, and a username/password fallback. Reedy and profile changes require a full sign-in.
deviation_notes: Replaces the code-plus-name-only flow. Schema is additive only. Depends on primary_cutover_blockers_20261003 Phase 2 (argon2 hashing). Design reasoning: advantage-pr/12-operations/primary-tutor-parity-gap-list.md section 0 and the 2026-10-03 login proposal.
